'''Iván Lorenzo Roncero''' (born 15 April 1986) is an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] who plays for Spanish club [[UD Benabarre]] as a [[Midfielder#Winger|winger]].

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in a friendly game against [[Gabon national football team|Gabon]] on 13 June 2003, becoming at 17 years and one month Andorra’s youngest player.<ref>{{NFT player|pid=8441|name=Iván Lorenzo}}</ref><ref> {{cite web |title=Andorra vs Gabon |url= https://www.national-football-teams.com/matches/report/19160/Andorra_Gabon.html |website=National Football Teams |access-date=29 November 2024}}</ref> However his record was beaten by [[Sergi Moreno]] in 2004.
